title: Now I call that friendly, don’t you?
html_source: This breakthrough encounter shows that Stephen has finally achieved the ability to speak to a girl of importance to him without the same awkwardness as before. He can feel an air of power in his new confidence with women. Women will no longer control his life through putting him into constant fear.

anchor.text: Now I call that friendly, don't you?
